Every identifier token of two or more characters is replaced with a deterministic, length- preserving pseudonym under a keyed permutation. The same source token always maps to the same output token (referential integrity), and distinct tokens map to distinct pseudonyms (injectivity). Tokens are matched by the regex `[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]+`. **String literals and comments are passed through VERBATIM by design and are not protected at all.** Import paths, URLs, SQL text, error messages, format strings and any literal data survive into the output unchanged.
